headline: Your website is
costing you clients.
problem.intro: You've built real expertise over years of work. But every week, prospects Google you, land on a site that doesn't reflect your level, and choose someone less qualified — because that person looks more credible online. That's not a skill problem. It's a visibility problem.

points.title: An average site signals average expertise
points.desc: Prospects form their first impression of you in 3 seconds. An outdated or generic site sends one message, loud and clear: 'This person doesn't take their professional image seriously.' Your actual expertise never even gets a chance.

points.title: Word-of-mouth only takes you so far
points.desc: Without a site that captures, qualifies, and converts visitors automatically — you're 100% dependent on referrals. Every prospect who doesn't become a lead is a silent loss you'll never know about.

points.title: The redesign that never happens
points.desc: Agencies quote 6–8 weeks and €8,000 minimum. Freelancers take forever. So it stays on the 'someday' list — while you keep losing clients to a site that doesn't do you justice.

headline: 5 days.
Zero surprises.
process.subtitle: No 3-hour scoping meetings. No endless back-and-forth. A refined 5-step process — AI-assisted for speed and precision — you know exactly where things stand every day.

steps.title: Brief — 30 min
steps.desc: You fill in a questionnaire at your own pace (20 min), then we have a 30-min call. I extract your positioning, ideal client profile, and business goals. Everything else is on me.

steps.title: Mockup approved before dev
steps.desc: I design a custom mockup suited to your activity and identity: colours, typography, structure, sections. You approve visually. Not one line of code until you say go.

steps.title: Copywriting
steps.desc: I write all your site content: headline, service pages, about, SEO meta descriptions. Every word is designed to convince — not just fill space. AI-assisted for speed, human-refined for voice.

steps.title: Site development
steps.desc: The approved design goes into development. Fully responsive across all devices, optimised Core Web Vitals, booking system integrated, fast load times.

steps.title: Launch + handover
steps.desc: Your site goes live on your domain. I walk you through editing your own content in 30 minutes — no code, no dependencies on me. You're 100% autonomous from day one.

about.headline: A senior builder. Not an agency.
paragraphs: I build digital systems for independent professionals — websites, automations, and tools that turn expertise into revenue. I started in Parisian agencies, learned what adds value and what just burns time, then went solo.
Today I work directly with you. No project manager in the middle, no junior learning on your budget. One person, responsible for the result from brief to launch.

My edge: I combine design, development, copywriting, and automation in a single delivery. I choose the right technology for your needs — Webflow for fast, client-editable sites; custom apps when you need something beyond a website.
about.currently: 🚐 Preparing a nomadic lifestyle — 100% remote from day one.

items.a: Established independent professionals who sell expertise — consultants, coaches, trainers, experts. If you have real experience, real results for your clients, and a website that doesn't reflect your level — this is for you. If you're just starting out or have a budget under €2,000, I'm probably not the right fit.

items.q: Is 5 days really achievable without cutting corners?
items.a: Yes — because the process is built for speed without compromise. The brief is tight (30 min), the copy is AI-assisted, and the development uses a refined component library. What takes an agency 6 weeks takes me 5 days.

items.q: I don't have time to brief you. How does it work?
items.a: The brief happens in two steps: a questionnaire you fill at your own pace (20 min), then a 30-min call. I handle everything from there — copy, design, development. Your time investment is minimal.

items.q: Will the site be genuinely custom?
items.a: Yes. I design from scratch for your specific positioning and sector. No templates, no copy-paste from another client. Guaranteed to be unique — or I redo it.

items.q: Which technology do you use and why?
items.a: I choose based on your actual needs. For sites you want to edit yourself without touching code, I use visual tools with a built-in content editor. For more complex needs — member areas, client portals, custom logic — I build a custom app. I explain the options during our call.

items.q: Can I edit the site myself after delivery?
items.a: Yes — always. Editing your own content takes about 30 minutes to learn. I walk you through it at delivery. You're 100% autonomous after that.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.a: You approve the mockup before development starts. Not one line of code is written until you've signed off on the visual. Revisions are included in every offer.
50% upfront at project start, 50% on delivery. Bank transfer or Stripe. Invoice within 24h of your commitment.

items.q: What are the running costs after delivery?
items.a: Between €0 and €25/month depending on the technical solution — I recommend the most cost-effective option for your project. You remain 100% owner of everything. Zero lock-in.
